lastCompletedStory.title: Wire the linter into the plan-runner audit path, folding findings into the re-plan loop

nextStoryContext: The deterministic oracle linter (lintPrd, US-001) is now fully wired into the plan phase: runPlanWorkerSequence's new readPrdContentFn seam runs it after the isPlannerNoPrd guard and before resolveAndSpawnAuditor, folding any finding into a synthetic { kind: 'audit-blocked', ... } result via buildLintBlockReport, so it rides the EXISTING runPlanPhaseWithReplan re-plan/escalation loop with zero new terminal kind. Production wiring: src/commands/status.ts's readPrd(cwd) is now exported and passed as readPrdContentFn in sidecar.ts's runProductionPlanPhaseWithReplan. If a future story adds a second lint rule to RULES (prd-oracle-lint.ts), no further plan-runner wiring is needed -- lintPrd's output already flows end-to-end. Two sibling test files now coexist for the same module: test/supervisor/plan/plan-runner*.test.ts (pre-existing US-005/US-003 suites) and test/supervisor/plan-runner.test.ts (this story, path pinned by the PRD's own oracle strings) -- a future story touching plan-runner.ts should check BOTH locations before assuming test coverage lives in one place.
